isolated_hosts.description: List of virtual hosts to isolate from each other. Each entry defines a vhost and optionally a list of allowed peer vhosts.

vhost.description: Virtual host (e.g., 'example.com') to apply isolation to.

allowed_peers.description: List of other virtual hosts that users on this vhost are permitted to interact with. An empty list means *no* cross-vhost communication (full isolation).
